body.x: The International Academy of Web Television (IAWTV) is proud to announce the 2nd Annual IAWTV Awards sponsors, including CES, Blip.tv, .AOL,.tv, Warner Brothers Digital, Maker Studios, Dolby Labs, DTS, Taboola, WGA, SAG-AFTRA, The 7th Chamber, PictureHealing.com, Audiosocket, and Mingle Media TV, as the official media sponsor.

“We are thrilled by the community’s overwhelming support of the 2nd Annual IAWTV Awards at the 2013 CES,” stated Amber J. Lawson, IAWTV Awards Chairman. “Sponsors are taking advantage of the grand stage of CES to reach the cross section of technology and content.”
The 2nd Annual IAWTV Awards, held on January 8, 2013 at the Venetian Theatre at The Venetian Resort Hotel in Las Vegas.

The IAWTV will once again be a part of the CES Entertainment Matters Conference. The full day conference track on January 9th, titled “The Digital Entertainment Transformation,” presents Influential leaders in web content creation, distribution, monetization, brand integration, audience development and the new online networks.

Speakers from AOL, Vuguru, YouTube, Alloy Digital, Machinima, BlackboxTV, and the web series Electric City, H+ The Digital Series, Halo 4: Forward Unto Dawn, and others will provide insights about best practices and business models that work.
